title: SYNTHETIC: SQL injection followed by a suspected web shell
description: SYNTHETIC. WAF logs on WEB-APP-03 show requests from 198.51.100.91 containing UNION SELECT payloads against /products.php, several returning HTTP 200. Twenty minutes later a new file /var/www/html/uploads/img_cache.php appeared and received POST requests from the same address. The web server process then spawned sh. The PHP file contents and full access logs are missing from this report.

attributes.note: SYNTHETIC test data created for CADE development. Not a real incident.
